prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on where in Charlotte you are and whether you want UV beds or a sunless spray tan. I can help find the top salons near you — but first a couple quick questions:

- Which neighborhood or ZIP code in Charlotte?  
- Do you want indoor UV tanning (beds), a spray tan / airbrush, or red-light/bronzing services?

Meanwhile, here’s a short checklist and tips to identify the best salon for you:

How to choose a great tanning salon
- Decide method: UV beds vs. professional spray/airbrush (spray is safer for skin cancer risk).  
- Look at ratings + number of reviews on Google and Yelp — prefer 4.0+ with many reviews.  
- Check photos: clean facility and up-to-date equipment.  
- Staff expertise: spray artists who do a consultation and patch test; techs who ask about skin type for UV sessions.  
- Equipment: newer, high-pressure beds or stand-up beds for UV; or DHA-based solutions and Norvell/VMart products for spray.  
- Hygiene & safety: disposable hair/eye protection, fresh towels, clearly posted sanitation procedures.  
- Pricing & packages: single sessions vs monthly memberships — compare cost per visit.  
- Policies: cancellations, patch tests, age/consent rules.  
- Ask for recommendations from local Facebook groups or Nextdoor for recent experiences.

Health note
- Indoor tanning increases skin cancer risk. If possible, choose spray tans or self-tanners instead of UV beds.

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you prefer UV or spray, I’ll pull together the top-rated local salons and give 2–3 specific recommendations with pros and cons.
